usage_instruction: Use this to determine technical scaling, availability strategy, and cost impact based on the selected Application Tier.

Tier_1_Mission_Critical.infra_impact: Requires Global Load Balancing and cross-region data replication (e.g., Spanner or Multi-Region GCS).

Tier_2_Production.infra_impact: Requires deployment across at least 3 zones within a single region.

Tier_3_Dev_Test.infra_impact: Basic deployment, no redundancy required. Scaling to zero where possible.

mandatory_rules: All data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) for IAM roles.
VPC Service Controls for data exfiltration prevention.
nfr_categories.cost_impact: Add $1.00/month per KMS key for CMEK.
nfr_categories.infra_impact: Requires VPC Service Control Perimeter in Terraform configurations.

metrics.logic: Apply Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) for GKE or Managed Instance Group (MIG) autoscaling for GCE.
